title: preregister-tier0-v4 MANIFEST provenance defect: reconciliation
root_cause: experiments/make_manifest.py (pre-fix) enumerated files via os.walk() over the raw local filesystem rather than Git's index/tree, so local working-directory state -- gitignored files, untracked files, a locally-deleted-but-uncommitted file -- silently leaked into or dropped out of the generated MANIFEST.json, independent of what the freeze commit's git tree actually contains. A second, independent bug in the same file's directory-skip logic (`not d.startswith(".git")`, intended to skip the internal `.git/` directory) also matched and skipped `.github/`, since the string ".github" starts with ".git" -- so every historical MANIFEST (v1 through v4) omitted the three committed CI workflow files even though nothing about them was locally dirty.
discovered_by: Running tools/freeze_check_prospective_v4.py's MANIFEST self-consistency check for the first time against a genuine `git worktree` checkout of preregister-tier0-v4 (detached HEAD at the freeze commit) rather than the development working directory, during the results/final_v4/ campaign run.
fix_commit_note: experiments/make_manifest.py rewritten to read exclusively from `git ls-files -s` (index) / `git ls-tree -r <ref>` (a commit) plus `git cat-file -p <blob-sha>` for content. tools/freeze_check_prospective_v4.py's MANIFEST check now verifies MANIFEST.json against the committed HEAD tree (experiments.make_manifest.verify_against_ref) instead of a second filesystem walk. Regression tests: tests/unit/test_make_manifest.py (8 tests). preregister-tier0-v4 itself is NOT retagged or modified by this fix -- see preregister-tier0-v4.1.
